title: Chapter 784
paragraphs: Chapter 784
Episode 193. The Shamaness(2)
Countless Kellic Ziphres filled the Teia Plains.
However, they were only Kellic Ziphres in appearance, just empty monsters formed by soul energy.
Jin concluded as such. If they were all the real Kellic, Ziphr would have already conquered the world and more.
"What on earth is going on?"
"Hehe, it's just full of things that we can kill without worries."
It was like the day when Jin returned from Lafrarosa and first came out to the Mithra Desert. The party easily fought off the swarming monsters and assessed the situation.
"Valeria, how about the record magic?"
"The soul energy is thick and it's causing a lot of interference. The tower, where the event started, is also too far. We might need to get further inside."
"We'll have to proceed while dealing with all of these. Owl, you don't need to worry about hiding. For some reason, I think Veradin knew I would come... and left this place alone."
It wasn't just an intuitive feeling.

At this point, large forces are struggling to deal with the remaining chaos contamination zones in the world. In such circumstances, it was impossible for Ziphr to remain so quiet while their heart, the Tower of Stories, was in this state.
"Show me what you're curious about, and you solve the problem. Does that mean Veradin left this area alone for that purpose?"
"Yes. Although the soul energy is thick, it's not to the extent that it can't be resolved with Ziphr's abilities. The monsters looking like Kellic also have low combat power."
They weren't all weak like the first monster that was killed.
Among them, some occasionally used magic of considerable level. It was a weakened form of the magic used by the real Kellic Ziphr.
Of course, even taking that into account, there was no reason for Ziphr to leave the vicinity of the Tower of Stories alone. Owl and the party nodded in agreement to Jin's words.
"So you're saying that Ziphr might not know the exact cause of this situation here."
"Yes, Sirius. If we look at the records, there should be some clues about that."
[Grrr...]
Swish-!
Each time the party swung their swords, the monsters disintegrated into particles.
But upon closer observation, the particles didn't just evaporate, they converged into soul flames burning like fires all over the plains.

Then, they were reborn from the black flames in the form of Kellic and targeted the party. Although it wasn't a threat, it meant that the land could not be reused without a 'fundamental purification.'
The party advanced without hesitation toward the tower.
The reason to visit enemy territory without permission had become even clearer. The current state of the Teia Plains could be thought of as Ziphr's 'failed attempt to birth another abomination.'
Jin carefully observed the battlefield as he moved.
'30 Li. No, with this level of soul energy, it should be problematic up to 50 Li outside the Tower of Stories.'
It was a clear indication of the fierce battle that took place here. Traces of dragons' claw marks and all kinds of high magic were spread throughout the plains.
The most notable were the puddles still holding clear water and the pillar-shaped rocks soaring to the sky.
It meant that beings with the highest authority over water and earth had participated in the battle.
The first to come to mind were the dragons of Itelmyon and Ricta, Tu-Yan and Finia. The first sentence described in Valeria's record window was the fact that the two had participated in the battle.
"If Tu-Yan and Finia participated, it means that Veradin himself stepped forward, but that guy appeared healthy at the Federation's joint meeting just a while ago, after Cadun withdrew."
Although Ziphr's numerous experiments and the misuse of Marston had significantly increased Veradin's power, it was not enough to stand against Jin in his view.
However, as they got closer to the tower, the traces of battle that became more visible were of a scale that even Jin could not avoid injury.
There were still spaces maintained by magic used during the battle.
When they had reached about half the distance to the tower, the party unexpectedly came across a large flame pearl burning furiously in the middle of the plains.
Although it had lost some shape, that flame pearl was clearly a magic left as a legacy by the Magic Emperor Liol Ziphr.
"Annihilation Flame Pearl, Magic Emperor Type 2..."
Around the flame pearl were magics that would have fought against it at the time. They were the traces of all sorts of Ziphr's magic spells, including the Blue Flower Magic Eye.
The fact that the magic still maintained its shape meant that the caster was alive.
The record magic indicated that the owner of that flame pearl was Kellic Ziphr.

<Ten days ago, the magic that Kellic Ziphr unfolded against his son Veradin Ziphr. Even after the battle ended, the Annihilation Flame Pearl, Magic Emperor Type 2, remains, maintained by his resentment and obsession.>
The eyes of the party members landed on the record window.
Upon reading the explanation and looking again, the monsters in the form of Kellic were pouring magic power into the flame pearl, like throwing firewood to keep the fire from going out.
"The magic cast against Beradin, the puzzle is almost complete. The center of the battle was Kellic, Hwarong Cadun, and Beradin."
"The point that they are the resentment of Kellic is interesting. Does it mean that Beradin betrayed Kellic first?"
Jin and Valeria said.
"If Kellic went berserk, he might have been initially captivated by resentment, hatred, and madness due to the spirit."
The important thing is what happened to Kellic, who is clearly still alive.

"It seems clear why Beradin left this fire pearl untouched. He's trying to confirm Kellic's life or death through it. Therefore, Kellic probably fled during the battle. It's clear that Kellic went berserk...."
Jin paused for a moment to think about the 'condition' of a rampage. There were two conditions for a rampage as Jin knew it.
First, the chaos goes berserk when it is stimulated by a larger chaos. The rampages of the likes of Yona and Amella in the past are typical.
Second, a rampage through someone's use and schemes to control the power of chaos.
Rosa accepted chaos through the prophet and became a monster. If it's the latter, it means that Kellic was also aided by an entity like a prophet.

Either way, it was an issue that could bring great danger to the world. The party continued towards the Tower of the Story, passing by the fire pearl. Kellic's obsessions kept coming. Even if it's cut, there's no end.
Finally, the Story Tower began to appear.
Among Zifl's magic towers, the most overwhelmingly high and gigantic tower. Even though the top of the tower was completely shattered, it did not lose its oppressive feeling at all.
The distance between the party and the tower is just about one mile.
At this distance, the troops stationed in the tower should have been firing magic. Even if Owl's stealth abilities were fully utilized.
But the tower showed no reaction as if it were completely empty. It looked as if it had been abandoned, and Kellic's obsession was buzzing around it.
And the obsessions gathered near the tower no longer attacked the party.
They didn't even look at the party when they came close, and they all bowed towards the tower. Precisely, towards a person kneeling in front of the tower.
"A person?"
Although it had been so ever since monsters in the shape of Kellic popped out, it was an exceptionally bizarre scene. The monsters seemed to be worshipping like a god.
It was a woman.
She was kneeling at the entrance of the tower, seemingly unaware of the party's proximity.
"That woman, it seems like she's praying...?"
"Heh, how should we kill her?"
"No, sister. She's a person we need to identify."
The party carefully observed the energy emanating from the woman. It was a golden aura, subtly enveloping her, much like the power of a veil. Clearly, it was the energy of the sun god.
They moved past the prostrated obsessions of Kellic and approached the woman. The woman didn't react at all until the party was right behind her, but when Yona tried to touch her, she spoke.
"Please wait a moment, guests. Until my prayers are finished."
The party couldn't help but be taken aback by her words.
The woman, of all people, had precisely detected Yona, who was about to discreetly poke her back.
At least 10-star level was required to vaguely perceive the current Yona.
However, there was no feeling of the warrior's energy from the woman.
Jin decided to follow the woman's words. She was a character never known before, so there was a need to be careful.
Instead, Valeria opened the record window. The woman did not ask them to stop, perhaps unfolding the record magic right next to her wasn't a hindrance.
"<...Beradin Zifl and Hwarong Cadun were at odds and a battle ensued.>"
"<In the battle, Hwarong Cadun died once..., ..., Kellic Zifl, who went berserk..., tried to destroy the Story Tower.>"
The records of that day were described more smoothly than before in the record window, as they had gotten closer to the magic tower.
"<...Kellic Zifl desired the power of the monster....>"
The eyes of the party members looking at the record window were growing larger. So far, there was strong circumstantial evidence that Kellic intended to transform into a monster.
The record was interrupted for a moment.
Sweat was beginning to bead on Valeria's forehead as she began to concentrate again. She was struggling with a single sentence that should have appeared in the record window.
"<...Beradin Zifl deceived Hwarong Cadun... Hwarong Cadun couldn't match Beradin....>"
In the midst of these interesting records appearing in fragmented sentences,
The woman stopped praying.
And at the same time, Valeria was surprised and looked back and forth between the record window and the woman.
'As soon as this woman finishes praying, the records suddenly start appearing easily?'
Others may not have noticed, but Valeria was well aware. The woman's prayer had an impact on the records.
The woman got up, turned around, and introduced herself.
"I apologize for showing you a rude image while I was finishing my prayer. I am Sanna, the shamaness of the Sun."
